items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Jerry Mengo a drummer who was half French, half American, Django Reinhardt and a French pianist named Leo Detemple... Jerry played nice swinging drums

ctx.x: I had learned to eat raw oysters which I had never eaten back home and that was a surprise to Beezie. I had moved into the appartment two weeks before Beezie arrived and after the dinner I took her home and she was surprised again when she saw the appartment.

The 21st of November I did a concert at the Ecole Normale de Musique with George Johnson, Jerry Mengo a drummer who was half French, half American, Django Reinhardt and a French pianist named Leo Detemple.

It was the first time I ever did a jazz concert and I must say the French were way ahead of Americans in the line of giving jazz concerts because I had never heard of any being done in the States. Armstrong had
